about: Castlane questions (outline review section 6: 10 to 15 written after LAB-23, scored as their own row, never mixed into the lab's 48). Same label shape as lab/queries.json: targets is a list of targets, each a list of acceptable alternatives {doc, section?, contains?}; a chunk matches if it comes from that doc, overlaps that section and contains the phrase (case-insensitive). 'asker' sets the principals the question is scored under; 'current_only' means a superseded or deleted document never counts as a hit. Labels are verified by check-facts.ts.
